name: tia-portal-mcp-readwrite
display_name: TIA Portal MCP - Read and Write
description: Explore, configure and automate TIA Portal through typed tools and the public Openness API.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to local TIA Portal V17, V18 or V19 using a fixed ReadWrite broker and exact-version workers. Includes project and PLC browsing, content capture, compile, import/export, hardware workflows and a schema-guided public API interface with events and callbacks. Generic native calls require expected project context and explicit acceptance of unclassified effects, which can include file writes, downloads and PLC changes. Typed workflow exports use an output root; generic native paths are not an operating-system sandbox. Siemens runtime DLLs are not bundled. This experimental release has build-only evidence.

tia_version.title: TIA Portal version
tia_version.description: Use auto when exactly one bundled version is installed, or enter V17, V18 or V19.

output_root.title: Export output directory
output_root.description: Typed workflow exports stay beneath this directory. Generic native calls can have broader file effects.
